title: 修饰与连接
goal: 形容词副词与比较、介词、连词、情态动词

steps.title: 一个有趣的故事
lines: A
The story was really interesting.
这个故事真有意思。
B
Yes, I was very interested in the ending.
是啊，我对结局很感兴趣。
A
The writer works hard. She writes well.
作者很努力，写得很好。
steps.note: interesting 和 interested、well 和 good、hard 和 hardly —— 形容词和副词里最容易错的几对。

steps.title: 形容词修饰名词，副词修饰动词
body: 形容词：放在名词前（a careful driver）或系动词后（He is careful）。
副词：修饰动词（drive carefully）、形容词（very good）、整句（Luckily, ...）。
多数副词 = 形容词 + ly：slow → slowly, easy → easily, happy → happily。
特殊：good → well；hard → hard（hardly 是“几乎不”）；fast → fast；late → late（lately 是“最近”）。
-ed 和 -ing 形容词：I'm interested（人感到）/ The book is interesting（事物令人）。bored / boring, tired / tiring。
ex: The movie was boring, so I was bored.
电影很无聊，所以我觉得无聊。

steps.title: -ing 和 -ed 形容词：interesting 还是 interested
what: -ing：事物本身给人的感觉 —— The story is interesting / boring / surprising.
-ed：人的感受 —— I'm interested / bored / surprised / tired / excited.
一对一对记：interesting / interested，boring / bored，exciting / excited，tiring / tired，confusing / confused
why: -ing 是“让人……的”（主动发出感觉），-ed 是“被……的”（被影响而产生感觉）。The movie is boring（电影让人无聊）/ I'm bored（我被弄得很无聊）。
zh: 中文“我很无聊”和“这部电影很无聊”都是“无聊”。直译成 <s>I'm boring</s> 意思就变成“我是个无聊的人”。
ex: The movie was boring, so I was bored.
电影很无聊，所以我觉得无聊。
It was an exciting game. Everyone was excited.
比赛很精彩，大家都很兴奋。

drill.q: The lecture was so ___ that I fell asleep.

a: I'm interested in history.
I am interested in history.

steps.title: good / well，hard / hardly，late / lately
what: good 是形容词，well 是副词：She is a good singer. / She sings well.（well 作形容词时指“身体好”：I'm well.）
hard 既是形容词也是副词：He works hard.　hardly 是“几乎不”：I can hardly hear you.
late 晚（副词也是 late）：He arrived late.　lately 是“最近”。
why: 大多数副词 = 形容词 + ly，但这几个例外最常用、也最常考。hardly / lately 加了 ly 意思全变了。
zh: 中文“他工作很努力”“他几乎不工作”差别很大，英语只差两个字母：works hard / hardly works。
ex: She sings well. She's a good singer.
她唱得好。她是个好歌手。
steps.sum: good 形 / well 副；hard 努力 / hardly 几乎不；late 晚 / lately 最近。

drill.q: He works ___. He is never lazy.
I can ___ hear you. Please speak louder.

steps.text: I was very interested in the ending.
steps.focus: INTERESTED 重音在第一个音节

a: at
I'm good at math.
I am good at math.
I'm good at maths.
I am good at maths.
I'm afraid of dogs.
I am afraid of dogs.

points: 形容词修饰名词或放系动词后；副词修饰动词、形容词、整句。
重点：事物 -ing（interesting），人的感受 -ed（interested）。
重点：good / well、hard / hardly、late / lately。
be interested in、be good at、be afraid of。

steps.title: 买手机
lines: A
This phone is cheaper than that one.
这台手机比那台便宜。
B
But that one is better. It's the best phone in the shop.
但那台更好，是店里最好的。
A
It's also the most expensive!
也是最贵的！
B
Well, it's not as cheap as this one, of course.
当然，没有这台便宜。
steps.note: cheaper、better、the best、the most expensive、as cheap as：比较的三种说法。

steps.title: 比较级和最高级：怎么变
what: 短词（一个音节，及 -y 结尾的两音节词）加 -er / -est：tall → taller → the tallest；big → bigger → the biggest；easy → easier → the easiest
长词（两个音节以上）用 more / most：expensive → more expensive → the most expensive
不规则：good / well → better → best；bad → worse → worst；many / much → more → most；little → less → least；far → farther / further
最高级前一般加 the，后面常跟 in / of 表示范围：the best in the shop
why: 短词加词尾、长词加 more —— 是为了好读：expensiver 太拗口。
zh: 中文比较只加“更”“最”，形容词不变；英语形容词要变形，而且不能“双重比较”：<s>more cheaper</s>、<s>most best</s>。
ex: This bag is cheaper than that one.
It's the hottest day of the year.
这是一年中最热的一天。
Her English is better than mine.
This is the most expensive phone in the shop.
steps.sum: 短词 -er/-est，长词 more/most；good → better → best，bad → worse → worst。

drill.q: This bag is ___ than that one.
It's the ___ day of the year.
This phone is ___ than that one.

drill.zh: 这是我们城市最高的楼。
a: This is the tallest building in our city.
It's the tallest building in our city.
This is the highest building in our city.

steps.title: as … as：和……一样
what: as + 原级 + as：和……一样 —— He is as tall as his brother.
否定：not as … as = 不如 —— This phone is not as cheap as that one.
as soon as possible 尽快；the same as 和……一样
why: as…as 中间放的是原级（不变形），因为它说的是“相等”，不是“更”。
zh: 中文“他和他哥一样高”“这个不如那个便宜”，中国学生常在 as…as 中间放比较级：<s>as taller as</s>。
ex: He is as tall as his brother.
This one is not as good as that one.
Please reply as soon as possible.
steps.sum: as + 原级 + as；not as … as = 不如。

drill.q: He is as ___ as his brother.

a: possible
This phone is not as good as that one.
This phone isn't as good as that one.
This phone is worse than that one.

x: More and more people work from home.
越来越多的人在家工作。
My bag is the same as yours.

steps.text: It's the best phone in the shop.

steps.a: More and more people work from home.
steps.zh: 越来越多的人在家工作。

steps.a: It's the best phone in the shop.

steps.zh: 越来越多的人在家工作。
a: More and more people work from home.
More and more people are working from home.

points: 重点：短词 -er / -est，长词 more / most；不规则 better / best、worse / worst；不能 more cheaper。
重点：as + 原级 + as；not as … as 不如。
more and more 越来越多；the same as 和……一样。

steps.title: 在路上
lines: A
Where are you?
你在哪儿？
B
I'm on the bus. I'll be at the station at seven.
我在公交上，七点到车站。
A
OK. I'm in the café, on the second floor.
好，我在咖啡馆，二楼。
B
See you in ten minutes.
十分钟后见。
steps.note: on the bus、at the station、at seven、in the café、on the second floor：介词选错，是中国学生英语里最多的小错误。

steps.title: 时间：at 点，on 天，in 段
what: at + 时刻、点：at 7, at noon, at night, at the weekend（英式）
on + 某一天：on Monday, on May 5th, on my birthday, on Monday morning
in + 一段：in July, in 2025, in summer, in the morning, in the 1990s
不加介词：today, tomorrow, yesterday, this / next / last week
why: 从小到大：点（at）→ 天（on）→ 更长的一段（in）。具体到某一天的上午，就跟着“天”走：on Monday morning。
zh: 中文“在”一个字通用：“在七点”“在周一”“在七月”。英语要按时间长短选介词；还常常多加介词：<s>on next Monday</s>、<s>in this week</s>。
err: next / last / this 前不加介词
steps.sum: at 点、on 天、in 段；next / last / this 前不加介词。

steps.title: 地点和交通：at 点、on 面、in 里
what: at + 一个点（看作位置）：at the station, at home, at the door
on + 表面、楼层、街道：on the table, on the wall, on the second floor, on Main Street
in + 空间内、城市国家：in the box, in the café, in Tokyo
交通：on a bus / train / plane（能站着走动的）；in a car / taxi（只能坐着）；by bus（方式）
why: on 和 in 的交通区别很形象：大巴、火车、飞机上能站起来走 → on；小汽车、出租车只能坐在里面 → in。
zh: 中文“在车上”只有一种说法；英语 on the bus / in the car 不同，是口语里最常听出“中式”的地方之一。
ex: Your keys are on the table.
We live on the fifth floor.
steps.sum: 点 at、面 on、里 in；bus / train on，car / taxi in。

a: by
I'm on the way.
I'm on my way.
I am on my way.
I am on the way.

x: They spoke at the same time.

steps.text: I'm on the bus. I'll be at the station at seven.
steps.zh: 我在公交上，七点到车站。

steps.a: I'll be at the station at seven.

a: We live on the second floor.
We live on the 2nd floor.

points: 重点：时间 at 点、on 天、in 段；next / last / this 前不加介词。
重点：地点 at 点、on 面、in 里；on the bus，in a taxi，on the second floor。
by Friday 不迟于周五；in the end 最后；on the way 在路上。

steps.title: 下雪天
lines: A
Why didn't you come yesterday?
你昨天怎么没来？
B
Because of the snow. It was snowing, so I stayed home.
因为下雪。在下雪，所以我待在家里。
A
I wanted to call you, but I was too busy.
我想给你打电话，可太忙了。
steps.note: because、because of、so、but：连接句子的小词，中国学生最常犯的错是“两个连词一起用”。

steps.title: because 和 so 不能一起用；although 和 but 也不能
what: 英语一个句子里只用一个连词连接两个分句：
Because it rained, we stayed home. ✓ 或 It rained, so we stayed home. ✓ —— 但不能 Because it rained, so we stayed home.
Although it was late, he kept working. ✓ 或 It was late, but he kept working. ✓ —— 但不能 Although…, but…
why: 连词的作用就是把两个分句连起来，一个就够了；用两个，等于中间多了一个“接头”，句子结构就坏了。
zh: 中文“因为……所以……”“虽然……但是……”成对出现，所以中国学生几乎都会写成 <s>Because…, so…</s>。这是托业和写作里扣分最多的错误之一。
ex: Because I was sick, I stayed home.
I was sick, so I stayed home.
Although it was expensive, I bought it.
It was expensive, but I bought it.
err: Because I was sick, so I stayed home.
Because I was sick, I stayed home.
Although it was late, but he worked.
Although it was late, he worked.
steps.sum: 因为……所以……、虽然……但是……：英语只留一个。

o: Because I was sick, so I stayed home.
Because I was sick, I stayed home.
Although it rained, but we went out.
Although it rained, we went out.

drill.q: It was raining, ___ I took a taxi.

a: Although it was expensive, I bought it.
It was expensive, but I bought it.
Although it was expensive, I still bought it.
It was expensive, but I still bought it.
Even though it was expensive, I bought it.

steps.title: because + 句子，because of + 名词
what: because 后面接完整的句子（有主语和谓语）：because it snowed
because of 后面接名词：because of the snow
同理：although + 句子 / despite + 名词
why: because 是连词，连接句子；because of 是介词短语，介词后面接名词。
zh: 中文“因为”后面接什么都行：“因为下雪”“因为雪”。英语要看后面是句子还是名词。
ex: We stayed home because it snowed.
因为下雪，我们待在家里。
We stayed home because of the snow.
The flight was late because of the weather.

drill.q: I was late ___ the bus didn't come.
You can have tea ___ coffee. (二选一)

x: The game stopped because of the rain.
She is not only smart but also kind.

steps.text: It was snowing, so I stayed home.
steps.zh: 在下雪，所以我待在家里。

steps.a: She is not only smart but also kind.
It was snowing, so I stayed home.

a: She is not only smart but also kind.
She's not only smart but also kind.
She is not only clever but also kind.

points: and 并列、but 转折、or 选择、so 结果、because 原因。
重点：because / so、although / but 只能用一个。
重点：because + 句子；because of + 名词。
not only … but also … 不但……而且……

steps.title: 能帮我一下吗？
lines: A
Could you help me with this box?
能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？
B
Sure. But you mustn't lift it alone — it's too heavy.
当然。但你别一个人搬，太重了。
A
Do I have to sign anything?
我要签什么吗？
B
No, you don't have to. You'd better hurry, though.
不用。不过你最好快点。
steps.note: could、mustn't、have to、don't have to、had better：同样是“要不要”，语气差别很大。

steps.title: 情态动词 + 动词原形
what: 情态动词（can, could, may, might, must, should, will, would）后面一律接动词原形，而且没有三单变化：She can swim.（不是 cans / can swims）
否定直接加 not：can't, shouldn't, mustn't；疑问把情态动词提前：Can you…? Should I…?
why: 情态动词表达的是说话人的态度（能、可能、应该、必须），它本身已经承担了“谓语”的语法功能，后面的动词只需要提供意思，所以用原形。
zh: 中国学生常在 can 后面加 to 或 -s：<s>She can to swim</s>、<s>He can swims</s>；或者问句忘了倒装：<s>You can help me?</s>
steps.sum: 情态动词 + 原形，不加 to、不加 s。

drill.q: ___ you help me with this box?

a: You should see a doctor.
You should go to see a doctor.
You should go see a doctor.

steps.title: mustn't（禁止）和 don't have to（不必）
what: must：必须（说话人认为）　have to：不得不（客观规定）
mustn't = 禁止：You mustn't smoke here.
don't have to = 不必（可以做，但没必要）：You don't have to come early.
had better + 原形 = 最好（否则有不好的后果）：You'd better hurry.
why: 肯定时 must 和 have to 差不多，否定时意思完全不同：mustn't 是“不许”，don't have to 是“不用”。
zh: 中文“不必”和“不许”分得很清楚，但学英语时很多人把 mustn't 理解成“不必”。托业听力里这个区别会直接决定答案。
ex: You don't have to pay. It's free.
I have to work on Saturday.
err: You mustn't come tomorrow.（想说“不用来”）
You don't have to come tomorrow.
steps.sum: mustn't 不许，don't have to 不用；had better + 原形。

drill.q: You ___ smoke here. It's not allowed.
Tomorrow is Sunday. You ___ get up early.

a: better
You don't have to come so early.
You don't need to come so early.
You don't have to come this early.
You needn't come so early.

x: I have to work on Saturday.

steps.text: Could you help me with this box?
steps.zh: 能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？

steps.prompt: 给同事写一条 3–4 句的英文留言：请他帮个忙（Could you…?），说明原因（because），提醒一件必须 / 不必做的事。
steps.hint: 检查：情态动词后用原形？because 和 so 只用了一个？介词 on / at / in 对吗？
steps.focus: modals, mustn't vs don't have to, because / so, prepositions of time
steps.model: Hi Tom, could you send me the report before Friday? I need it because the meeting starts on Monday morning. You don't have to print it — just email it to me. Thanks!

points: 重点：情态动词 + 原形，没有三单、不加 to。
重点：mustn't 禁止，don't have to 不必；had better 最好。
礼貌请求：Could you …? / Would you mind …ing? / May I …?

steps.title: Two Coffee Shops
steps.note: 先关掉译文读一遍，只用学过的词和本单元的重点。读不懂的句子点 ▶ 听一遍，再打开译文核对。
lines: There are two coffee shops on my street.
我住的街上有两家咖啡店。
The first one is bigger and cheaper than the second one.
第一家比第二家更大、更便宜。
But the second one is quieter, and its coffee is much better.
但第二家更安静，咖啡也好得多。
The owner of the second shop is a young man called Leo.
第二家店的老板是个叫利奥的年轻人。
He is very interested in coffee, and he is good at talking with customers.
他对咖啡很感兴趣，也很会和顾客聊天。
He makes every cup as carefully as possible.
每一杯他都做得尽可能用心。
Because of this, more and more people come to his shop, although it is small.
正因如此，越来越多的人来他的店，尽管店很小。
Last week, I asked him, "Could you teach me how to make good coffee?"
上周我问他：“你能教我怎么做好咖啡吗？”
He said, "Sure. But you have to practice every day, and you had better buy a good grinder."
他说：“当然。不过你得每天练习，最好再买一台好的磨豆机。”
Now I am not only a customer but also his student.
现在我不仅是他的顾客，还是他的学生。
My coffee isn't as good as his yet, but it is getting better.
我做的咖啡还没有他的好，但越来越好了。

steps.q: Why do more and more people go to Leo's shop?
o: It is bigger than the other shop.

steps.q: What is true about the first coffee shop?
What does Leo say the writer has to do?

o: Because of the rain, we stayed home.
Because the rain, we stayed home.
Because of it rained, we stayed home.
steps.e: because of + 名词；because + 句子。

steps.q: "My coffee isn't as good as his." means:

steps.zh: 我不仅是他的顾客，还是他的学生。
a: I am not only his customer but also his student.
I'm not only his customer but also his student.
I am not only a customer but also his student.

points: 重点：比较 —— bigger and cheaper than / much better / as good as / as carefully as possible。
重点：连接 —— although（不再加 but）、because of + 名词、not only … but also。
情态动词 + 原形：Could you …?（礼貌请求）/ have to（必须）/ had better（最好）。
be interested in / be good at + 名词或 doing。

I didn't go out ___ it was too cold.

a: than
